authoring_brief: Create separate teal forest island and angular grey mineral island bodies with cliff facets and grounded docks. Separately author a forest timber workshop with evergreen trees and stacked logs, and a rocky mine portal with rails and a chimney furnace. Use muted ink outlines, jade/stone/ochre colors; no baked UI text. Preserve independent bodies/landmarks; no huts borrowed as industry art.
